setup: [a message claiming to be the player's manager or a supplier says a deal is confidential and cannot go through the normal channel] [a short video call shows a face that looks like the boss but keeps the camera low]
ask: [the person on the video call, speaking as the boss with the camera kept low, asks the player to pay the company invoice to a new account or in gift cards, and to skip the usual approval and keep it from colleagues because of the confidentiality]
usualEnding: The company payment lands in a mule account and the faked video cannot be traced back to the boss. The real boss learns of it from the bank.
realTwin: The real manager asks in the team chat for an invoice to be raised through the usual system, with the normal approver copied in.
